correctness.rationale: The norm formula is reconstructed from three facets and all six edges are exhausted under explicit linear isometries and the skew pair swap. Same-/opposite-facet configurations have squared objective at least 1+tau^2. On the other four facets an exact convex squared-max function has a zero subgradient at the stated rational candidate: for tau<=rho kink weights kappa and theta lie in [0,1]; for tau>=rho the unique interior a* and ridge weight theta=tau^2/(1+tau^2) annul both partial subgradients. Convexity proves global rather than local optimality. A universal admissible test pair bounds the edge-orbit minimum by 1+tau^2. The reciprocal identity extends to tau>1. Explicit rational checks and numerical threshold corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof.
